name: classone-automation
description: AI Sales Automation Platform for Class One Systems

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,backend,frontend -c green,blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:27017 && npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
